title: AI impersonation
summary: A voice, video, or message appears to imitate someone you know while asking for action.
scenario: The content is convincing but the request is unusual, urgent, or secret.
warning_signs: Unexpected urgency from a familiar person
Refusal to verify through another channel
safe_actions: Use a pre-existing contact method to verify
Do not transfer money or disclose codes based on the media alone
Ask a question only the real person can answer if safe
recovery_guidance: Contact the payment provider if funds were sent
Tell the real person through a trusted route and preserve evidence
reporting_guidance: Keep the original file or message safely
Use a platform or reporting destination opened independently
prevention_tips: Voice and video are not proof of identity
Create a family or team verification phrase through a safe channel
false_positive_notes: A real person may sound or look different; independent confirmation resolves uncertainty.
